description: This role deploys no software: no container image, no upstream project, nothing in defaults/main.yml that names a version. The shared preset's custom.regex manager - the one that reads `# renovate:` annotations out of defaults/main.yml - therefore matches nothing here, and `//patch-automerge`, which only widens that manager, would be inert. It is deliberately not extended.

What Renovate does track here is repository housekeeping: GitHub Actions, the prek pin in mise.toml, the pre-commit hook revisions, .python-version, molecule/requirements.txt and the collection the Molecule scenario pulls in. The shared preset already branch-automerges all of those, so there is nothing left for a local rule to add.
